question.text: The crystal system of a compound with unit cell dimensions  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.387</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.387</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi></math> and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mn>0.504</mn></math>  nm and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">β</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msup></math>  and  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">γ</mi><mo>=</mo><mtext>12</mtext><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi></mrow></msup></math>  is

solution.text:
For the given crystal,

a=b≠c,α=β=90o,γ=120o

These are the characteristic of a hexagonal system.
